name: IBM Generative AI Engineering Professional Certificate

entry.name: IBM Generative AI Engineering Professional Certificate
entry.note: A multi-course professional certificate, not a proctored exam; building applications with large language models
entry.audience: Developers and data scientists building applications on large language models

covers: Generative AI and large language models
Python for data science and AI
Building AI applications with Python and Flask
Transformers such as BERT, GPT and LLaMA
Frameworks such as Hugging Face Transformers, PyTorch, RAG and LangChain
reading.format: A 16 course series delivered online through Coursera, with hands on labs, projects, practical evaluations and a guided project to build a real world generative AI application. The page says it takes about 6 months and is available in 19 languages.
reading.summary: The IBM Generative AI Engineering Professional Certificate is a 16 course series from IBM offered on Coursera. It teaches generative AI, large language models and natural language processing, and includes hands on work building and deploying AI applications. Completing it earns a career credential intended to show employers practical generative AI engineering skills.
reading.audience: The page says it is for aspiring gen AI engineers, AI developers, data scientists, machine learning engineers and AI research engineers. It states no prior experience is required and lists the level as beginner.
reading.prerequisites: The page says no prior experience is required and lists the level as beginner.
